text:
ITEM 1 | Two large pieces of fish fillet, skin-side visible with dark grey-green skin and light pinkish-tan flesh, grill-marked with charred browned edges; the larger piece roughly 6 x 4 cm and about 1.5 cm thick, the smaller piece beneath it roughly 5 x 3.5 cm; moist, flaky-looking, holds shape, sits on the lower left of the plate | 150

ITEM 2 | Julienned red bell pepper strips, bright red, glossy and slightly moist, about 4-5 cm long and 0.3 cm wide, scattered across the fish and plate center | 12

ITEM 3 | Finely chopped green onion/scallion pieces, bright green, slightly moist, in small rings and bits about 0.5 cm, clustered in the center over the fish | 8

ITEM 4 | Thin pale pink sprouts or microgreens, fine wispy stems with tiny leaves, dry and delicate, scattered in a small tangle over the center of the fish | 3

ITEM 5 | Small fresh green leaves, bright to dark green, flat and slightly glossy, a few about 1-2 cm across, arranged on top at the upper center of the fish | 2

ITEM 6 | Thin brownish-orange sauce or glaze smear, slightly glossy and semi-liquid, pooled in small amounts at the lower right edge beside the fish fillet, about 3 x 2 cm | 5

ITEM 7 | Partial plate on the left edge holding cooked orange-red carrot pieces, dark roasted vegetable chunks, and yellow-green pieces with browned, glossy, oily surfaces, partly cut off by the frame | 60
